title: DeLonghi Magnifica Evo $599.40, La Specialista Arte $479.40 Delivered @ De'Longhi Australia
body:
Deal: DeLonghi Magnifica Evo $599.40, La Specialista Arte $479.40 Delivered @ De'Longhi Australia

[GSDLG] Can't really compare automatic or pump with grinder against a pump without grinder. Plus, if pump without grinder is what you're after we have our Dedica range, which are rated very highly.
[syswong] Problem with DeLonghi is still using the unpopular 51mm portafilter….
After so many years I don't know why DeLonghi is not switching to 54mm… must be a ego thing that will make Breville/Sage right and DeLonghi is wrong.
[GSDLG] I'm unsure the reasoning tbh but I can let our team who are in touch with R&D know the feedback.
We are working on bringing a bottomless portafilter in which will hopefully be available by the end of this year but not sure if that will make it what you're looking for.
[noslappers] Is there any real science behind the difference? Why aren't they all standardizing at 58mm, as I believed that was the standard? Is this just cost-cutting?
[syswong] Breville bambino plus is good, Breville bambino is a total different machine, just a similar name.
La Specialista Arte using 51mm portafilter which is not very ideal….
DeLonghi Magnifica Evo however is a full automatic and for some user it may be a better than Breville bambino plus.
[Nametaken] Their 40% off is basically standard price everywhere else. What gives?
[GSDLG] No it's not?
ECAM290.31.SB next cheapest $669 and EC9155.W is $497 elsewhere. Plus no gifts.
[jv] I got the DeLonghi Magnifica S for just over $300 over a year ago and it's been great …
[ihbh] I got the Dedica for $104.50 in 2018, the Dedica grinder for $89 and tamper ~$20 both last year and a cheap knock box and it's all been great too. The kids love making coffee for me.
But if there was an automatic maker for around your price when I needed the replacement, I would have considered it.
[jv] I found it here in the low qty forums…
It was an ebay seller clearing them out and I think there was a further 22% off at the time… It was a good deal.
Only the milk frothing is manual, which i prefer… The rest is just push a button. Easy to clean too…
[AreYouAWiiizard] Isn't the milk manual so there's no point of the coffee part being automatic or am I misunderstanding?
[jv] Yes, the milk frothing is manual, which I prefer ….
